column1: # The modes shirabe's decider declarations ship with: one row per declared
# value. scripts/check-decider-declarations.sh fails when a template's
# effective mode for a value (shadow when the template sets none) differs from
# its row here, when a declared value has no row, or when a row names a value
# no template declares. Promoting a value means editing its mode in the
# template and here, in the same change.
# A declaration whose input is a slice has the slice's contract (sources, the
# script that builds it, why it's enough, its measured size) in
# under coordinate/pick-choice there. coordinate's decision_verdict reads the
# whole entry decision-next.sh writes, coord/decision.json, and its measured
# A decider-check gate's criteria aren't rows here: a check has no declared
# values, only a pass, a fail and an escape, and its mode lives in the
# template. Its slice's contract is in references/jev-criteria.md too:
# work-on's review_level_check runs level_fits_facts on review-level.sh slice,
